title: Form logic and a coded result
summary: A form that changes with the answers and the person - and a test result saved as a coded FHIR Observation.
shows: A family drawn with a form that has a Genetic testing tab added to open-pedigree's built-in form. Open a person's form to see it change: Overall interpretation and Result shared with the family appear only for people tested, and Why not tested only for people who weren't; Result shared stays greyed out until there is a result; and Prenatal ultrasound findings appears only for the pregnancy, a predicate on the person rather than on another answer.

Overall interpretation is saved as a FHIR Observation coded LOINC 51968-6, with LOINC's own answers (Positive, Negative, Inconclusive, Failure), so another FHIR system reads David's positive result as a coded Observation, not as text. The built-in form's Sex item shows one more kind of logic: an option a person can't have, such as a sex that contradicts their partnerships, is disabled by a per-option predicate.
hard: A form like this has to be evaluated for each person as their answers and their place in the pedigree change, and what it records has to come back intact: every answer here survives a GA4GH FHIR save and load.

questionnaire.what: Shown only when Genetic test done is yes (enableWhen), and saved as an Observation with a fixed LOINC code (mapsToObservation, item.code 51968-6) and LOINC answer codes.
Shown for people tested, but disabled (greyed out, not hidden) while Overall interpretation has no answer (disabledWhen).
Shown only when Genetic test done is no.
Shown only for a fetus: its enableWhen names the isFetus predicate (questionnaire-enable-predicate) instead of another item.
